passes.name: ab075
passes.why: per player: its variants interleaved and rotated per stop, 3 repeats, the first segment again at the end (noise gate: within 3 %). HarbourDistrict runs as-built only (the old-* variants refuse to run there: PerfSwitches throws on a switch the scene has no target for)

variants.name: as-built
variants.why: each scene as Sky saw it: OldTown with the old pipeline (PC_RPAsset of OldTownArt: MSAA 4, depth + opaque texture, GRD off, old renderer with Harbour fog and depth-normals SSAO), its lens (Gaussian DOF, sun flare with occlusion, bloom 0.8/0.6) and its crowd; HarbourDistrict as shipped

variants.name: old-no-crowd
variants.why: OldTown only: the glTF crowd and cars hidden (renderers off under 'District crowd and traffic' and 'Southside crowd and traffic'). as-built - this = cut 1

variants.name: old-no-msaa
variants.why: OldTown only: crowd off and MSAA 1. old-no-crowd - this = cut 2

variants.name: old-lean-lens
variants.why: OldTown only: crowd off, MSAA 1, DOF and the flare off at play, depth and opaque textures by request. old-no-msaa - this = cut 3

variants.name: old-our-pipeline
variants.why: OldTown only: crowd off, rendered through OUR pipeline asset and renderer (MSAA 1, GRD on, no Harbour fog pass, our lens). Content-only difference against HarbourDistrict as-built
